review_candidates.title: Senior Project Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description INSUTECH is a leading international provider of insulation, construction, packaging, and decoration technologies and solutions, operating since 1987. The company serves diverse markets with innovative, high-quality products designed to meet complex industrial and commercial requirements. INSUTECH emphasizes technology-driven solutions, reliability, and long-term partnerships with clients and stakeholders. Team members join a stable, growth-oriented organization that values technical excellence and practical problem-solving. The company offers opportunities to work on impactful projects in a dynamic manufacturing and engineering environment. Role Description The Project Engineer role is a full-time, on-site position based in 10th of Ramadan. This role is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing engineering projects from concept through implementation, ensuring alignment with technical standards, timelines, and budget. Day-to-day tasks include preparing project plans and schedules, reviewing technical drawings and specifications, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and monitoring progress to address risks and issues. The Project Engineer will work closely with production, maintenance, and procurement to support project delivery, oversee installation and commissioning activities, and ensure compliance with safety and quality requirements. The role also involves reporting on project status, optimizing processes, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the facility. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Project Engineering and Mechanical Engineering skills, with the ability to interpret technical drawings and apply engineering standards in industrial environments. Candidates should possess Project Management and Project Planning skills, including experience in scheduling, resource allocation, budget monitoring, and risk management. Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, engage stakeholders, and prepare clear technical reports and documentation. Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a Industrial engineering ,experience in construction, industrial, or manufacturing projects are beneficial. Additional beneficial qualifications include familiarity with safety and quality management systems, proficiency in engineering and planning software (e.g., AutoCAD, MS Project), strong problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to work on-site in a fast-paced environment.
review_candidates.verification: Exact LinkedIn jobs-guest jobPosting endpoint returned a job detail page during this run
review_candidates.review_policy: Always pass exact-detail candidate to ChatGPT; closed status, weak keyword evidence, noisy title, or freshness conflict are annotations only
